components.name: Pin dot
components.description: A single cell in the PIN row. State shows the input state: Empty, Filled, Error, Success. Used only inside Code input.

components.name: Code input
components.description: The PIN row — shows how many digits have been entered and the result. Length: 4 or 6 cells. State: Empty, Typing, Error, Success. Helper text is switched on with a boolean.

components.name: Pinpad key
components.description: A single key of the Pinpad keypad. Element: Digit, Clear, Face, Finger, Text, Empty. State: Default, Pressed.

components.name: Pinpad
components.description: A numeric keypad for entering a PIN. Bottom left is the bottom-left key: Face (Face ID), Finger (Touch ID), Text (a text action) or Empty. The bottom-right key is always Clear.

Do / Don’t
Two pairs — reporting errors and the bottom-left key.
Do
Incorrect code
In the error state, add a short message as well as colour. The message shows for 0.5 seconds, then the row clears and the user enters the code again.
Don’t
Don’t show an error by colour alone. A user who can’t distinguish colours won’t know what went wrong.
